what: HIGH (code audit AUD-20260927-CA-B02-training-harness-swallows-signal-errors-as-zero-trades): scripts/training/backtest_helpers.py:simple_backtest() swallows every exception from the caller-supplied build_signal() (`except Exception: sig = None`) and, when a hypothesis genuinely finds no setup, returns the identical {'trades': 0, 'expectancy_r': 0.0, 'win_rate': 0.0, 'sharpe': 0.0, 'max_dd_r': 0.0} in both cases. scripts/training/run_experiment.py (the autonomous training-run entrypoint dispatched by .github/workflows/training-run.yml on every push to claude/training-plan-*) renders this as '| H1 | OK | E[R]=0.000 ... |' in SUMMARY.md -- indistinguishable from a hypothesis that legitimately found no edge. Per docs/claude/training-improvement-workflow.md Stage 4, a reviewing session reads that SUMMARY.md and decides adopt/reject/needs-more-data per hypothesis, so a broken build_signal() (wrong column name, bad indexing, any bug) reads as a clean null result rather than a failure needing a fix. scripts/training/** (run_experiment.py, data_loader.py, backtest_helpers.py) carries zero test coverage (confirmed: no test file anywhere under tests/ references scripts.training or scripts/training). LOCATION: scripts/training/backtest_helpers.py:26-32 (silent except), :48-49 (collapsed 0-trade return); scripts/training/run_experiment.py:80-90 (renders trades=0 as 'OK'). PROPOSED FIX: re-raise (or record and report) build_signal exceptions distinctly from a legitimate None/no-signal return (e.g. a build_signal_errors counter surfaced in the result dict and in SUMMARY.md), and add tests/scripts/test_training_backtest_helpers.py covering both paths.
